name: aiuic-workspace
description: AIUIC + Hepta: the layer between knowing what the user wants and the write happening.

scripts.test: for p in core resolve hepta tools compose memory brand devtools present eui eval; do (cd packages/$p && npx vitest run) || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck: for p in core resolve hepta tools compose memory brand devtools present eui eval; do (cd packages/$p && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json) || exit 1; done
